text:
Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens from today’s five Serie A games, as Napoli in crisis host leaders Lazio, Milan visit Genoa, there’s Monza-Atalanta, a massive Inter vs. Como clash, then Juventus away to Fiorentina.
We begin at 11.30 GMT (12.30 CET) at the Stadio Maradona, where Napoli desperately need to turn things around, but are against a Lazio side flying high in top spot.
At 14.00 GMT (15.00 CET), Milan and Atalanta also try to shake off European setbacks with their trips to Genoa and Monza respectively.
All eyes on San Siro at 17.00 GMT (18.00 CET) for a huge Inter vs. Como Scudetto battle to fuel Cesc Fabregas ambition.
Finally, the bitter grudge match between Fiorentina and Juventus at 19.45 GMT (20.45 CET).
- All
- Favourites 0
Another Atalanta chance, Ederson stings Tornqvist’s gloves from distance.
Cisse and Diawara off, Hutchinson and Terracciano on for Milan.
Genoa introduce Baldanzi and El Shaarawy for Marcandalli and Messias.
Carboni and Zeballos on, Kouadio and Robinson off for Monza.
Nearly 2-0! Mario Pasalic runs onto the through ball, his angled drive towards the far bottom corner is kept out by the outstretched leg of Tornqvist!
Atalanta roll across from the left again, but Elmas sees his finish blocked off. Monza will regret not making more of their first half domination.
Robinson snapshot straight at Carnesecchi from the edge of the area.
There are three red cards flashed at members of the Milan staff on the bench! Tension…
Tension is getting sky high here!
First Maignan adn Vitinha get into a bit of handbags, both quite childish about it.
Then Rabiot robs Marcadalli and tries to go on the counter, he is dragged down for a yellow card! Milan want a red, and Rabiot is booked for dissent, but that is in midfield it’s far too far away to be a red…
That could not be more against the run of play!
Bernasconi gets down the left, roll across is only fingertipped into the path of Krstovic, who is always ready to pounce!
Kouadio pulls back from the right, it is charged down into the path of Colombo, who can’t keep his finish on target at the near post.
Also no changes.
No changes.
Marco Carnesecchi made four saves in a single move and that sums up the match. Atalanta have been dreadful, but they’re hanging in there.
Alphadjo Cisse and Christian Pulisic made the most of Genoa defensive errors. Milutin Osmajic header ruled offside.
Zappacosta blasts well over from distance, he claims there’s a deflection, but it just wasn’t very good…
Vitinha nutmegs De Winter, but is then blocked off, while Wiafe barges Modric over and wins a corner. Not a good corner, cleared by Rabiot.
Cross floated in by Messias from the right, Ostigard towering header, but Maignan plucks it out of the air!
Atalanta waking up a bit, but the Krstovic shot smothered easily at the near post by Tornqvist.
Wiafe surges forward, his snapshot is beaten away by Maignan!
A rare Atalanta attack sees De Ketelaere sprint down the left, Colombo puts him off just enough that he hits the side-netting!
Bit of tension between De Winter, Vitinha and Osmajic after a challenge in midfield, De Rossi and Amorim getting fired up on the touchline too.
Ramos surges through the middle, spread to Pulisic and then Moreira, cut inside and shot charged down by Ostigard!
It’s all Monza, Mangas pulls back from the left and Scalvini clears with difficulty. Atalanta can’t get out of their half.
Promising Genoa attack falls apart when Junior Messias picks the wrong pass for Vitinha.
Genoa free kick into the box, but Vasquez can’t keep the header down.
digest_he: מחזור משחקים עמוס מתקיים בליגה האיטלקית וכולל התמודדויות מרכזיות ברחבי המדינה. נאפולי המדממת פוגשת את המוליכה לאציו באצטדיון דיאגו ארמדו מראדונה. במקביל, מילאן ואטאלנטה מתארחות אצל גנואה ומונצה בהתאמה, במטרה להתאושש מהפסדים באירופה. בהמשך הערב, סן סירו מארח את המפגש המסקרן בין אינטר לקומו, ופיורנטינה פוגשת את יובנטוס למשחק טעון ביניהן.
